next_step: Start 4-week POC: ingest 10k calls, integrate Twilio + S3 + Zendesk, run QA rubric
notes: Account: omnichannel contact center provider (in-house platform + outsourcers). ~600 agents on platform, spikes to 1.2k concurrent live streams during promos.
Primary need: reliable post-call synth summaries + QA highlights for supervisors; faster agent assist snippets during live calls.
Latency/throughput targets: agent-assist suggestion <150ms p95, post-call summary available <20s after call end for 95% of calls.
Cost sensitivity: target cost per session < $0.06 (must hold at scale), willing to trade model size vs quantization if clear perf wins.
Model preferences: prefer open/quantized LLMs (Llama-family variants) with Redwood-verified smaller fallback; want deterministic fallback routing for capacity storms.
Security: strict residency for EU accounts, KMS-managed keys, SOC2 plus audit logging surfaced in console.
Integrations: Twilio for PSTN + WebRTC ingestion, S3 for raw transcripts, Zendesk for ticket creation and summary attach, single sign-on (SAML) for supervisors.
Quote from VP Ops: "We need summaries that cut QA time in half and coaching highlights that point to behavior not just transcript slices."
POC scope: 4 weeks; metrics = summary accuracy (rubric), time-to-summary, CPU/GPU cost per 1k calls, failure rate during 2 simulated spike windows.
Wants: canary rollouts for models, per-route throttles, automatic fallback to cheaper model on overload, and clear cost + latency dashboards.
SE notes: likely candidate for Dedicated on reserved pools + Redwood Optimize to tune batching/quantization; POC will validate 1.2k concurrent streaming calls across 3 regions.
Risk: legal is strict about transcriptions stored outside EU region for EU customers; need explicit retention controls in POC.
Preference: prefer minimal infra changes — Redwood Private in VPC mode if Legal blocks hosted; otherwise Dedicated with VPC peering.
Next: legal to return DPA + residency confirmation, engineering to provide Twilio test keys, schedule POC kickoff (target week of 2026-03-02).
Comment: earlier fidelity demo had hallucination in 'recommended next steps' — requirement to include confidence indicators and provenance for coaching highlights.
